title.en: Tale 10 — The Ring in the Well

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: Juha's ring fell into the well.
The well was deep and the water far down.

sentences.ar: הוא הביא צלחת יוגורט ושפך אותה פנימה.
sentences.en: He brought a plate of yoghurt and poured it in.

sentences.ar: השכן ראה אותו ושאל: מה אתה עושה?
sentences.en: The neighbour saw him and asked: what are you doing?
Juha said: I am making yoghurt.

sentences.ar: השכן אמר: באר לא נהיית יוגורט.
sentences.en: The neighbour said: a well does not become yoghurt!
Juha said: and what if it does?
